case.lsjh.more:
Participants: the trip was organised by Southwest Finland Waste Management (LSJH) as part of the Ohituskaista uudelleenkäyttöön reuse project. Alongside LSJH and its project partner the Sustainable Development Association / Turku Ekotori, the group included people from Turku University of Applied Sciences' Baltic2Hand and Circular Tiedepuisto projects, the cities of Raisio and Turku, the Helsinki Region Reuse Centre and retail companies.

What united the participants was a wish to find ideas and inspiration for building reuse more firmly into their own organisations' projects and everyday work.

Sites: UpcycleCentrum Almere, De HER – Upcycle Mall Rotterdam, SCRAP, Buurman Rotterdam and BlueCity. What they had in common was the strong commitment of the people and companies running them to circular economy goals.

Read the trip report (PDF, in Finnish)

Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them Lassila & Tikanoja, VTT, Micropolis, Lapland UAS and OAMK. Twenty people in all.

q.rr: FinDera found exactly the right full-scale vertical farming site in Belgium for the needs of our development project, and the visit gave us valuable hands-on knowledge. I have also taken part in other waste management site visits organised by FinDera, which have been highly successful occasions to network and get to know new technologies.

q.rr.role.description: Client testimonials, Rosk'n Roll Oy Ab — client testimonial.
q.lsjh: We have used FinDera's services several times, because Martin comes up with new, interesting site suggestions that were previously unknown to us. The best part is how effortless it is: we get expert content design and all the practical travel arrangements at the same time.
q.lsjh.description: Client testimonials, Lounais-Suomen Jätehuolto Oy — client testimonial.
q.lsjh.role: Research and Development Manager, Lounais-Suomen Jätehuolto Oy
q.lsjh.role.description: Client testimonials, Lounais-Suomen Jätehuolto Oy — client testimonial.
q.osao: The trip gave us practical information about new ways of working and new technologies, and broadened our perspectives and contacts. Martin knows how to build a whole in which expert content, smooth arrangements, cultural understanding and warm interaction support one another.
q.osao.description: Client testimonials, Koulutuskuntayhtymä OSAO — client testimonial.
q.osao.role: Project Development Manager, OSAO Joint Municipal Authority
q.osao.role.description: Client testimonials, Koulutuskuntayhtymä OSAO — client testimonial.
q.ladec: FinDera found us the most interesting sites across the whole value chain and handled the arrangements turnkey, very smoothly. The first trip was such a success that we decided to run a second one in the same year — and we recommend FinDera for similar benchmarking needs.
q.ladec.description: Client testimonials, Lahden Seudun Kehitys LADEC Oy — client testimonial.

q.ladec.role.description: Client testimonials, Lahden Seudun Kehitys LADEC Oy — client testimonial.
q.ely: Working with Martin Brandt and FinDera Consulting was very smooth and professional. Martin succeeded in assembling a high-calibre expert programme and an extensive network, through which participants gained valuable practical lessons and international perspectives on climate change adaptation solutions.
q.ely.description: Client testimonials, Varsinais-Suomen ELY-keskus — client testimonial.
q.ely.role: Water Management Specialist, Southwest Finland Vitality Centre
q.ely.role.description: Client testimonials, Varsinais-Suomen ELY-keskus — client testimonial.
q.salpa: FinDera built an excellent package at board level: relevant sites, well-prepared meetings and smooth arrangements. We gained a valuable knowledge base to support investment decisions, and the visits led to new openings for collaboration.
q.turkuamk: FinDera delivered the set of site visits very smoothly — the programme was well paced and its content matched our needs precisely. We gained a great deal of new, hands-on knowledge about stormwater and greywater solutions.
q.turkuamk.role: Senior Specialist / Project Manager, Sustainable Environment, Turku University of Applied Sciences
q.turkuamk2: FinDera is a long-standing and valuable partner for us, one that finds the sites and organisations matching our objectives across many project contexts: the sites and contacts have always been chosen purposefully, and the arrangements have without exception been well prepared. The cooperation has given us new networks and practical lessons we have been able to apply directly in our own work. We recommend FinDera to organisations looking for hands-on learning and networks in sustainability themes.
q.turkuamk2.role: Lecturer, Sustainable Environment, Turku University of Applied Sciences
q.muhos: Martin Brandt planned and delivered the benchmarking trip to Germany with great professionalism and a strong customer focus. The trip ran effortlessly for us from beginning to end, and the sites we visited brought several new ideas for developing Muhos Biopark, particularly around the circular economy, involving residents, renewable energy and the new business opportunities of the green transition.
q.muhos.role: Head of Economic Development, Muhos Biopark / Municipality of Muhos
